ranking_basis: Impact and frequency, measured evidence, complexity, regression risk and architecture; exploratory CPU timings are local synthetic workloads, not production SLOs.

top3.evidence: With a predecoded guest response, 100 MiB read: p50 365.606 ms, peak additional Python allocations 368.909 MiB (7 timing samples, separate tracemalloc).
top3.impact: File previews, attachments and harness reads; stops event-loop stalls and large temporary allocations.
top3.risk: Low: parse only the two header lines, preserve bounded reads and containment.

top3.evidence: Generated added-file diff: 100k lines / 1.89 MB p50 233.400 ms; 500k lines / 9.89 MB p50 1216.937 ms; 7 samples. Parser traverses all lines multiple times.
top3.impact: Every edit/write patch persisted before its live event; delays tool progress on large generated files.
top3.risk: Low-medium: one bounded scan retaining the existing collapsed-preview contract.

top3.evidence: Existing complete-list benchmark at HEAD: 1 repo 7 guest execs / p50 6.878 ms, 5 repos 23 execs / p50 27.769 ms on local runtime, 3 samples. Validations and entries are sequential.
top3.impact: Git panel refresh on multi-repo workspaces; SSH round trips add latency beyond local timings.
top3.risk: Medium: bound concurrency while preserving per-repo locks, fail-closed validation, error cleanup and sorted results.

other_opportunities.evidence: Static inspection: loads full pending gate rows when only session IDs are needed, repeats descendant traversal for every returned session. Needs DB profiling; ranked below measured paths.
Static inspection: sorts and rebuilds all blocks on each immutable streaming parts change; current memoization and virtualization already limit impact. Needs native render profiling.
Static inspection: repeated full-session passes; called during every mobile snapshot. Normal creation order often makes traversal linear, so confidence lower.
Static inspection: computed block derivation and page identities; existing stable membership optimization already removes repeated sorting. No new bottleneck proven.
